title: Исход 29 — Exodus 29
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: Возьми молодого ___ и двух баранов без изъяна.
cases.translation: Take a young bull and two rams without defect.
cases.explain: Бык is the direct object of возьми (take); for an animate masculine noun the accusative equals the genitive → быка.

cases.translation: Bring the young bull to the Tent of Meeting.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to / toward) takes the dative → шатру.

cases.sentence: Приведи Аарона и его сыновей ко входу в шатер собрания и омой их ___.
cases.translation: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.
cases.explain: The means of washing (омой водой = wash with water) is expressed by the instrumental → водой.
The preposition на with motion (onto) takes the accusative → голову.

cases.sentence: Возьми масло для ___ и помажь его.
cases.translation: Take the anointing oil and anoint him.
cases.explain: The preposition для (for) takes the genitive → помазания.

cases.sentence: Возьми и нанеси ___ на рога жертвенника бычью кровь.
cases.translation: Take some of the bull's blood and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger.
cases.explain: The instrument of the action (нанеси пальцем = apply with the finger) is expressed by the instrumental → пальцем.

cases.sentence: Заколи его перед Господом у ___ в шатер собрания.
cases.translation: Slaughter it before the Lord at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
cases.explain: The preposition у (at / by) takes the genitive → входа.

cases.translation: Burn the whole ram on the altar.
cases.explain: The preposition на meaning "on" a location (no motion) takes the prepositional → жертвеннике.

reading.ru: Возьми молодого быка и двух баранов без изъяна.
reading.question: Which animals were to be taken?
options: A young bull and two rams without defect
A ram and a bull with defects
reading.correct: A young bull and two rams without defect
reading.explain: The text specifies one young bull and two rams without defect.

reading.ru: Приведи Аарона и его сыновей ко входу в шатер собрания и омой их водой.
reading.question: What was to be done with Aaron and his sons at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting?
options: They were to be washed with water
They were to be anointed with blood
They were to be sent away
reading.correct: They were to be washed with water
reading.explain: Aaron and his sons were to be brought to the entrance and washed with water.

reading.ru: Теперь священство принадлежит им по вечному установлению.
reading.question: On what basis does the priesthood belong to Aaron and his sons?
reading.explain: The priesthood belongs to them by a perpetual (eternal) statute.

reading.ru: Мясо быка, шкуру и кишки сожги за пределами лагеря, это приношение за грех.
reading.question: Where were the bull's meat, skin, and entrails to be burned?
reading.explain: The meat, skin, and entrails were to be burned outside the camp as a sin offering.

reading.ru: Ежедневно приноси на жертвенники двух годовалых ягнят, одного утром, а другого вечером.
reading.question: How many lambs were to be offered daily, and when?
options: Two year-old lambs, one in the morning and one in the evening
Two lambs both in the evening
reading.correct: Two year-old lambs, one in the morning and one in the evening
reading.explain: Two year-old lambs were to be offered daily, one in the morning and one in the evening.

reading.ru: Я буду жить среди израильтян, я буду их Богом, они будут знать, что я Господь, их Бог, который вывел их из Египта, чтобы жить среди них.
reading.question: What will the Israelites come to know?
options: That He is the Lord their God who brought them out of Egypt
That the desert is their home forever
That they must return to Egypt
reading.correct: That He is the Lord their God who brought them out of Egypt
reading.explain: The people will know that He is the Lord their God who brought them out of Egypt to dwell among them.
